subject: How to figure out which records are being dropped from DetectionHistory

messages.author: 9365e798eed43895
messages.subject: How to figure out which records are being dropped from DetectionHistory
parts:
Hi,

I am creating detection histories for a couple species keep getting the message:

Warning message:
8 records were removed because they could not be assigned to an active station / session 

I have gone through my data and did find an error in one station name that accounted for some of the dropped records but not all. Is there a way to figure out specifically which records have been dropped so I can fix them? 

Thanks,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Re: How to figure out which records are being dropped from DetectionHistory
parts:
Hi Leigh,

please try with the development version from github and let me know if the error persists. The dev version should at least tell you which record cause the problems.

library(devtools)

install_github("jniedballa/camtrapR", ref = "dev")


apply(recordsF, 1, detectionHistory) does not work because apply() returns each row as a character vector, not a data frame. Hence the error. See:

data("recordTableSample")
apply(recordTableSample, 1, class)

Best,
Jürgen
